prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Straight-down view of a field of large matte six-sided hexagon tiles fading from white at one side to sky blue at the other, quiet and evenly lit. Subject spread along the horizontal centre line with wide quiet margins left and right. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one tile in amber glass near the lower right of the field. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
